Indian IT firms face business model disruption from AI and US policies

India's major IT companies are confronting an "identity crisis" as artificial intelligence (AI) begins to disrupt their established business models. This disruption is compounded by potential curbs on US green cards, which could impact the sector. The need for these IT giants to rethink their strategies and business approaches is highlighted by these converging challenges.
